tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Today we'll discuss the influence of peer pressure on teen behavior. Clearly, peer pressure can lead teens to make choices they might not otherwise make. On the other hand, some people believe that individual personality and family influence play a larger role in shaping teen behavior. Which do you believe has a greater impact on teen behavior? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think peer pressure has a significant impact on teen behavior. Teens often want to fit in with their peers and might make decisions based on what their friends are doing, even if it goes against their better judgment or how they were raised at home.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe that individual personality and family influence are more important. A strong sense of self and a supportive family environment can help teens resist negative peer pressure and make better choices.
